title: Globex — Account Notes
body: Globex is Acme's largest customer account, owned by Sam Reyes (Account Executive). Current ARR: $840,000, up from $620,000 at last renewal. Primary contacts: VP of Engineering (executive sponsor) and a Director of IT Operations (day-to-day admin). Deployment: 1,200 licensed seats. Recent activity: expanded to a second business unit in Q2 2026; a security questionnaire was completed in June ahead of the upcoming renewal. See the renewal-status and security-questionnaire notes for details.
